findings.text: the row's effective_status blocker list was narrowed to open_decisions, but no guard catches a revert: restoring decision_blockers here leaves all 107 text-only tests that read readiness or effective_status green (measured in a scratch tree at this head), and tests/test_closure_gates.py:76 covers only the decision-free plan-terminal fixture while tests/test_transition_gates_read_alike.py:162-163 asserts the served and the MCP rows — so the roadmap row would render blocked for a plan whose gate holds a choice, the exact symptom section 6 exists to remove.

the top-level decision tally was narrowed to open_decisions_report, and reverting it to decision_blockers_report likewise leaves the same 107 guards green (measured), so a gated decision silently re-counts as open in the roadmap payload's decision_readiness block.

the manifest omits measurement_module and measurement_cwd although its base arm measured a scratch tree exported to /tmp/base-reckon, which this node's own manifest spec requires them for; the shortfall is mitigated but not cured by cohort-base.log's header naming the pinned module and its cd, which is the evidence those keys exist to carry.

item_verdicts.diff: met — 445 insertions across seven files; the split is computed once in reckon/roadmap.py (execution_gates:272, closure_blockers:287, unsettled_decisions:362, the gated status at :337) and both readers consume it, while 0e4e159d removed the two MCP summary keys whose size the payload budget forbids (tests/test_mcp_views.py:260, :735).
item_verdicts.done_when: met — tests/test_transition_gates_read_alike.py:167 and :179 build exactly the two fixtures named and assert, for each, that the roadmap's ready_now, the served payload and the MCP projection agree and name the same blockers; the declared negative control ran twice and failed the closure-gate case at tests/test_transition_gates_read_alike.py:160 with the gate-borne blocker quoted, then passed 3/3 after the revert.
item_verdicts.goal: met — both readers now consume the roadmap's execution/closure split: reckon/serve.py:1867 extends the served plan's blockers from unpassed_gate_blockers(execution_gates(plan)) and reckon/mcp_views.py:1546 does the same for the MCP projection, so a plan whose only open gate is a decision-transition gate keeps its row in ready_now, names gate_blockers as empty and reads active on both surfaces.
item_verdicts.manifest: met with one recorded gap — status, commits, both suite arms, the negative-control log and follow_ons are present, and the cohort arithmetic reconciles (base 2 failed/826 passed/21 skipped/4 errors; head 1 failed/834 passed/21 skipped; zero added failure ids); measurement_module and measurement_cwd are absent although the base arm measured a scratch tree, which this node's own manifest spec requires them for.
item_verdicts.write_paths: met — git show --stat over 6277e533..ef4151e7 touches only the seven declared paths (the figures path carries one added PNG); no path outside the fence appears in any of the five commits.

justifications.durability: two changed behaviour sites in the roadmap status stack are unguarded — restoring the pre-change spelling at reckon/roadmap.py:1933 or :2318 leaves all 107 text-only tests that read readiness or effective_status green (measured in a scratch tree at this head, log f1-line-arm.log in the reviewing run's directory), so the transition split can silently regress to the symptom section 6 exists to remove.
justifications.evidence: the declared control is a real refusal at the named assertion, twice, with the post-revert pass, and the cohort delta shows zero added failure ids; one point withheld because the base arm's scratch tree is not recorded in the manifest's measurement keys.
justifications.fit: the split is expressed as public roadmap functions consumed by both readers, matching the module's existing separation, and the new test file's name and fixture style match its neighbours; one point withheld because two of the five commit subjects scope by the plan's own name, which the commit-message rule forbids (7 of the last 800 commits carry one).
justifications.goal_fidelity: the two readers consume the split and both fixtures assert agreement; one point withheld because the roadmap row's own effective_status — a value the goal's agreement claim also covers — is carried by an unguarded line.
justifications.scope_discipline: all five commits stay inside the seven declared paths, no path outside the fence appears in git show --stat, and no shared sprint or foreign plan state was touched.
